bio.text: Penny Brown Reynolds, a former state judge, is the Democratic nominee for Georgia Secretary of State in the November 2026 election, after winning the June 16 runoff.

According to a September 2025 news report on her campaign launch, she was a lawyer to Roy Barnes, Georgia's last Democratic governor, and served as Acting Assistant Secretary for Civil Rights at the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
The same report describes her as the host of the nationally syndicated television program Family Court with Judge Penny and an ordained minister.

sources.title: Former State Judge Penny Brown Reynolds Announces Campaign for Georgia Secretary of State
Republican Tim Fleming, Democrat Penny Brown Reynolds win Georgia secretary of state primary runoffs
